description: This file defines the NetNode class which extends PcbNode and represents a network node in a PCB, identifiable by an ID and optionally by a name. It includes logic for initializing nodes, printing debug info, and setting a static GND_NET_ID if the node is a ground.

classes.name: NetNode
classes.description: Represents a network node in a PCB with an ID and optional name, extending PcbNode.

methods.name: NetNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the network node, extracts ID and name from children, and sets GND_NET_ID if applicable.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the NetNode, displaying its ID.
